ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Validation_Rule_Exception__c.Run_Validation_Rule__c, ISCHANGED(Convert_Perform_Conversion__c), Convert_Perform_Conversion__c = true, OR( ISBLANK ( FirstName ), ISBLANK ( LastName ), AND( ISBLANK ( Email ), ISBLANK ( Phone ), ISBLANK ( MobilePhone ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must fill out these required fields in order to convert the Lead to a Contact: First Name, Last Name, and either Phone or Email.
